notes: All five styles transcribed from this page only; no other brand's file or page was imported. The page states the serial numbers shown are utilized with all Paloma brand systems; that applicability claim is recorded here, not verified against any other brand. Counting convention: character-position counting throughout. Style 3 confirms it: digit-only counting gives week 91 (invalid), character counting gives week 29, matching the page's bold '2910'. Style 1 gives the same result under both countings (no letter precedes its digits). Within-file patterns are pairwise disjoint: styles 1 and 3 are both 10 characters but start with a digit vs a letter; styles 2, 4, 5 have distinct lengths (15, 17, 9). No style on this page is held, so no shape-collision hold applies.

styles.notes: Page: month from the 1st & 2nd numerical digits, year from the 3rd & 4th numerical digits; page bolds '1204' (month 12 + year 04). Decoded values derived from the stated positions, not page-stated.

styles.era: 15-character serials in spaced groups, F/M date group (page Style 2)
styles.notes: Page: the date is coded in the middle group of digits following a letter designation of either 'F' or 'M' and 'represent the week and year of production'. Week-first order is the tested reading: year-first would make year 28, which is ambiguous under the century rule (1928 below floor, 2028 future), so it fails the page's own example; week-first gives week 28, year 2007. Example shown spaced as printed; the decoder strips spaces before matching. Decoded values derived from the stated rule, not page-stated.

Page: week from the 2nd & 3rd numerical digits, year from the 4th & 5th numerical digits; page bolds '2910' (week 29 + year 10). Digit-only counting is falsified here (week 91, invalid); character-position counting is used. Decoded values derived from the stated positions, not page-stated.
